properties.displayName: Public network access should be disabled for Container registries
properties.description: Disabling public network access improves security by ensuring that container registries are not exposed on the public internet. Creating private endpoints can limit exposure of container registry resources. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/acr/portal/public-network and https://aka.ms/acr/private-link. Enabled=true checks all matching in-scope resources; false skips the check.

metadata.description: Start in audit mode. Only effects supported by the source definition are available.
True checks every matching resource within the assignment scope; false skips the check. Use assignment exclusions or exemptions for exceptions. Select true or false; defaults to true.
